```{=html}
<div id="map-jul30" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-jul30').setView([37.8000, 126.8000], 10);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'🏨 Shilla Stay Seodaemun Seoul Station', lat:37.5572, lng:126.9680, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Shilla+Stay+Seodaemun+Seoul+Station' },
    { name:'🚇 DMZ Tour Departure · Myeongdong Station Exit 8', lat:37.56111290781287, lng:126.9857801664527, c:'#4A148C', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=125+Toegye-ro+Jung+District+Seoul' },
    { name:'DMZ — Dorasan Station 🪖 (Booked)', lat:37.9355, lng:126.6783, c:'#C62828', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=DMZ+Dorasan+Station+Korea' },
    { name:'Oegojip Seolleongtang 🍲', lat:37.51116819162925, lng:127.0541770932536, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Oegojip+Seolleongtang+Seoul' },
    { name:'Euljiro Alleys ☕', lat:37.5659, lng:126.9950, c:'#1565C0', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Euljiro+Seoul' },
    { name:'Hannam Oriental Roast Chicken 🍗', lat:37.53293874851522, lng:127.00606855952167, c:'#C62828', url:'https://share.google/zvcIu85n4XwzPMgQ8' },
  ];
  function routeLabel(n, color) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:'+color+';border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:1">'+n+'</div>', iconSize:[18,18], iconAnchor:[9,9] });
  }
  // Route 1: Shilla Stay → Myeongdong Station Exit 8
  L.polyline([[37.5572,126.9680],[37.56111290781287,126.9857801664527]], { color:'#4A148C', weight:3, dashArray:'6,5', opacity:0.7 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([37.5591,126.9769], { icon:routeLabel(1,'#4A148C') }).addTo(map);
  // Route 2: Myeongdong → DMZ (group bus)
  L.polyline([[37.56111290781287,126.9857801664527],[37.9355,126.6783]], { color:'#C62828', weight:3, dashArray:'6,5', opacity:0.7 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([37.7483,126.8320], { icon:routeLabel(2,'#C62828') }).addTo(map);
  // Route 3: DMZ → Oegojip Seolleongtang (return + late lunch)
  L.polyline([[37.9355,126.6783],[37.51116819162925,127.0541770932536]], { color:'#00897B', weight:3, dashArray:'6,5', opacity:0.7 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([37.7233,126.8662], { icon:routeLabel(3,'#00897B') }).addTo(map);
  // Route 4: Oegojip → Euljiro Alleys
  L.polyline([[37.51116819162925,127.0541770932536],[37.5659,126.9950]], { color:'#1565C0', weight:3, dashArray:'6,5', opacity:0.7 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([37.5385,127.0246], { icon:routeLabel(4,'#1565C0') }).addTo(map);
  // Route 5: Euljiro → Hannam Oriental Roast Chicken (dinner)
  L.polyline([[37.5659,126.9950],[37.53293874851522,127.00606855952167]], { color:'#E65100', weight:3, dashArray:'6,5', opacity:0.7 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([37.5494,127.0005], { icon:routeLabel(5,'#E65100') }).addTo(map);
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
})();
</script>
```
